title: SG-2.5 · Mocked-dependency unit tests for the manifest loader
summary: Unit tests with node:fs mocked cover valid and invalid manifests, dangling references and missing-asset fallbacks
description: Context: game/src/assets/loaders/manifestLoader.ts exports loadManifestFile, loadManifestWithFallback and checkAssetRefs. Existing tests (tests/manifestLoader.test.ts, manifestFallback.test.ts) use real temp directories, and tests/manifestRefs.test.ts covers checkAssetRefs in memory. Desired behavior: a suite where node:fs is fully mocked covers valid and invalid manifests, dangling references and missing-asset fallbacks. Why: the sub-goal requires all dependencies mocked.
acceptance_criteria: Given node:fs is mocked, when loadManifestFile and loadManifestWithFallback run, then no real disk access occurs
Given valid, schema-invalid, unreadable and missing-asset inputs, when the loader runs, then each yields the asserted result
Given refs absent from the manifest, when checkAssetRefs runs, then each dangling ref is reported

in_scope: New mocked unit tests for the manifest loader

definition_of_done: New mocked test files exist in the working tree and pass
